review_scope: Read-only integration review. No source changes or test execution.

findings.title: Relogin validation bypasses global error cleanup
evidence: The proposal throws validation failures from successHandler before loader cleanup.
Axios registers successHandler and errorHandler in one response interceptor pair.
A rejection from the fulfilled callback bypasses its paired rejection callback.
findings.consequence: Malformed renewal can leave global loading active and omit the shared error message.
findings.next_action: Route local validation failures directly through errorHandler with an AxiosError and the tagged request config.
limits: No runtime execution confirms this proposed integration.

findings.title: Delayed logout also needs session ownership
evidence: Timeout continuLogout waits one second before calling useServices.logout.
useServices.logout clears the active shared session.
The proposal invalidates responses at Logout start. It does not guard the delayed logout callback.
findings.consequence: A fresh login during the delay can be cleared by the older logout continuation.
findings.next_action: Capture the invalidated generation. Stop the delayed continuation after any newer session boundary.
limits: The current modal may make this interleaving uncommon. The shared login API remains available.

findings.title: Guard canceled callbacks before shared state effects
evidence: Axios checks cancellation at adapter settlement.
A later abort can occur before the response interceptor callback executes.
The current error handler still resets loading for ERR_CANCELED.
findings.consequence: Canceled work can install a refresh header or reset loading owned by replacement work.
findings.next_action: Add aborted-signal checking to success and an early ERR_CANCELED rejection to errors.
limits: This does not add server-side revocation guarantees.

limitations: Automated checks do not check the complete approved dictionary or grammar rules.
